<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/audits/policies"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves all asset audit policies configured for the current site and product. Audit policies define rules and schedules for verifying asset locations, conditions, and compliance.

**Policy Configuration:**
- `PolicyType` - The category of audit policy
- Affected asset groups and targeting rules
- Verification schedules
- Alert settings and assignee information

Returns the complete set of active audit policies that govern asset verification workflows in your organization.
